en: Board-approved data ownership policy; RACI matrix mapping each data domain to a named owner; signed owner-acceptance letters; annual review evidence.
Signed committee charter; meeting minutes (at least quarterly); terms-of-reference document; escalation log for data governance issues.
Published data governance policy version-controlled in the document management system; evidence of annual review and CISO/board approval; staff-acknowledgement records.
Automated or manually maintained data asset register showing asset name, owner, classification, location, and retention class; last-updated timestamp; reconciliation with CMDB.
Approved classification policy with tier definitions (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted); mapping to PDPL personal-data categories and NCA classification levels; board sign-off record.
DLP/classification tool configuration screenshots; regex/pattern library; scan coverage reports showing % of repositories classified; exception report for unclassified assets.
Sample labelled documents/emails/database column metadata; DLP policy configured to block unlabelled sensitive data transmission; label-stripping alert logs.
Training completion records (LMS extract) for all staff handling Confidential/Restricted data; awareness poster/communications; annual refresher attendance log.
Documented reclassification request form; approval workflow evidence; audit trail of classification changes with justification; quarterly review report from data owner.

name_en: Encryption at Rest for Sensitive Data
en: Encryption configuration evidence (TDE enabled on SQL Server, BitLocker/LUKS on endpoints, S3/Blob encryption policy); key management system inventory; algorithm compliance (AES-256); vulnerability scan confirming no unencrypted sensitive data stores.

TLS configuration review (minimum TLS 1.2; TLS 1.3 preferred); certificate inventory and expiry monitoring dashboard; network scan confirming no clear-text sensitive data channels; API gateway TLS enforcement policy.

KMS/HSM inventory; key rotation schedule and evidence of last rotation; key custodian assignment records; key ceremony documentation; access control list for cryptographic keys; HSM audit log samples.

name_ar: ترميز بيانات الدفع والبيانات عالية الخطورة
en: Tokenisation solution architecture diagram; scope of tokenised fields (PAN, national ID, etc.); de-tokenisation access control policy; audit logs of de-tokenisation events; PCI-DSS/SAMA alignment evidence where applicable.

DLP tool configuration baseline; content-inspection rule set (covering SSN/national ID, IBAN, credit card patterns, classification labels); policy exceptions log with approvals; monthly DLP incident summary report.

DLP alert queue records; triage SLA evidence (time-to-review per severity); escalation tickets raised; false-positive tuning log; monthly metric report (alerts raised, confirmed incidents, blocked events).

name_en: Access Control for Sensitive Data Stores
name_ar: التحكم في الوصول إلى مخازن البيانات الحساسة
en: RBAC/ABAC matrix for sensitive databases and file repositories; privileged-access review records (semi-annual); PAM tool audit logs; database activity monitoring (DAM) alerts; need-to-know justification for Restricted data access grants.

Approved de-identification methodology document (referencing ISO 29101 or NIST SP 800-188); list of approved techniques (pseudonymisation, k-anonymity, differential privacy); risk-assessment for re-identification for each technique tier.

Data masking tool configuration; evidence that production Confidential/Restricted data is masked before loading into non-production environments; sample masked-dataset schema comparison; developer environment access control policy.

name_ar: إخفاء هوية البيانات في التحليلات والتقارير
en: Privacy impact assessment for analytics use cases involving personal data; anonymisation process documentation; evidence of k-anonymity threshold applied; published-data review checklist before external report release.

name_ar: تقييم مخاطر إعادة التعرف على الهوية
en: Documented re-identification risk assessment methodology; assessments performed for each de-identified dataset release or major schema change; residual risk acceptance sign-off by data owner; remediation log where risk exceeded threshold.

Master DSA template approved by legal/DPO; executed DSA register with parties, purpose, data categories, and expiry dates; annual review evidence; PDPL Art.29 compliance checklist embedded in DSA approval workflow.

Register of cross-border data flows including destination country, legal basis, and adequacy decision or safeguard type; PDPL-compliant transfer mechanism documentation (SDAIA adequacy list reference or contractual clauses); transfer impact assessments for high-risk destinations.

name_ar: تصنيف البيانات ورسم خرائط متطلبات الإقامة
en: Data residency requirement register cross-referenced with asset inventory; evidence of sovereign/critical data hosted only in KSA-domiciled infrastructure; cloud storage region enforcement policy; periodic residency audit report.

SFTP/FTPS/HTTPS configuration standards; MFT platform inventory; encryption-in-transit coverage evidence; access log samples for file transfer events; prohibition of FTP/email for Restricted data without compensating controls.

name_ar: العناية الواجبة لمستقبلي البيانات من الأطراف الثالثة
en: Third-party security assessment questionnaire results; contractual data-protection clauses evidence; onboarding checklist for new data recipients; annual review of existing recipients; right-to-audit clause in active DSAs.

Board-approved retention schedule covering all data classes; mapping to regulatory mandates (SAMA, PDPL, NCA, SOCPA); last review date and approving authority; exceptions register with legal-hold justifications.
Retention policy configuration in EDRMS/archiving system; scheduled purge job logs; evidence of automated archiving after primary retention period; exception report for overdue purge items.

Legal hold issuance log with matter reference, custodians in scope, and data categories preserved; legal hold notice templates; suspension of scheduled purge evidence; hold release authorisation records.
Annual retention compliance audit report; sample testing of purge completion against schedule; findings and remediation tracker; Internal Audit sign-off.

Approved secure-erasure standard (NIST SP 800-88, DoD 5220.22-M equivalent); tool qualification list; configuration baseline for overwrite passes; verification method documentation (read-back verification).

Certified destruction vendor contract and current accreditation certificate (ISO/IEC 21964 or equivalent); destruction manifest records with asset serial numbers; witnessed destruction log or video evidence; certificate-of-destruction files.

Cloud storage deletion policy; evidence of cryptographic erasure (key deletion) or verified data deletion for decommissioned cloud volumes; cloud provider data-deletion confirmation records; decommission checklist for virtual machine images.

Centralised disposal register linking asset tags to destruction method, date, certifying officer, and certificate reference; quarterly reconciliation against asset inventory; 3-year retention of disposal records.

name_en: End-of-Contract Data Return & Destruction for Third Parties
name_ar: إعادة البيانات وإتلافها عند انتهاء العقود مع الأطراف الثالثة
en: Contractual data-return/destruction clause samples; contractor-provided destruction certificates on contract termination; verification checklist for data return completeness; time-bound destruction deadline enforcement log.

name_en: SIEM Integration for Data Leakage Events
name_ar: تكامل SIEM مع أحداث تسرب البيانات
en: SIEM use-case documentation for data leakage scenarios (bulk downloads, after-hours access, USB transfer); alert rule configuration screenshots; correlation rule testing evidence; SIEM coverage of DLP, DAM, and proxy event sources.

name_en: User & Entity Behaviour Analytics (UEBA) for Insider Threats
name_ar: تحليلات سلوك المستخدمين والكيانات للكشف عن التهديدات الداخلية
en: UEBA tool deployment scope documentation; baseline behaviour model configuration; high-risk user watchlist process; alert escalation records; quarterly insider-threat review report.
Network DLP (NDLP) or NetFlow inspection coverage map; policies blocking exfiltration via HTTP/S, email, FTP, and cloud storage; monthly exfiltration attempt report; blocked-channel evidence logs.

name_ar: مراقبة منع تسرب البيانات على الأجهزة الطرفية
en: Endpoint DLP agent deployment coverage report (% of managed endpoints); USB and removable-media block/alert policy; screen-capture and clipboard monitoring policy for Restricted data; agent health dashboard.

Documented data-leakage incident response playbook; tabletop exercise record (annual); incident closure reports with root-cause analysis; notification workflow for PDPL-reportable breaches (72-hour SDAIA timeline evidence).

name_ar: مراقبة الويب المظلم وبيانات الاعتماد المسربة
en: Dark-web monitoring service subscription evidence; alert records for organisational data detected in breach repositories; response workflow for leaked credentials (force-reset timeline); quarterly threat intelligence report.
